summary: MOOD for DESIGN — P0 aesthetic batch (Editorial Light Mode + cinematic image render + soft-pulse autosave + cinematic crop modal) frontend smoke. Logged in as designer@moodfordesign.com, opened TEST_F1_UI_lux. 8/9 spec items GREEN; only TEST 4 (Quick Adjust modal trigger via inspector-side file upload) was not exercised end-to-end through Playwright (multiple input[type=file] on the page made targeting unreliable) but the wiring is verified correct by code review at MoodboardEditor.jsx:1146-1178 (ImageUploader.onUploaded → setQuickAdjust({src}) → ImageQuickAdjust mounts; all required data-testids present in ImageQuickAdjust.jsx). KEY EVIDENCE — TEST1 workspace-mode-toggle: present in topbar; click flips html[data-workspace-mode] light↔dark; localStorage key 'mfd_workspace_mode' persists; survives reload (verified). TEST2 Editorial Light Mode: body bg = rgb(239,234,227) warm ivory, text = rgb(30,27,24) charcoal — matches Kinfolk/Aesop palette spec (note: requested swatch #F5F1EB ≈ rgb(245,241,235); shipped is rgb(239,234,227) ≈ #EFEAE3, a slightly cooler ivory but still warm-paper; main agent may want to bump the literal value if pixel-perfect to spec). TEST3 image rendering: 2× image-block-img on page 1, naturalWidth = 1622 and 400 (NOT broken), bp-img-in class applied, 0 lingering image-block-skeleton. TEST6 SOFT PULSE™ autosave: only a 1.5px round dot (w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--bp-primary)]/55) — NO 'Saving…' / 'Salvataggio…' text in steady state. status-saved/-saving/-unsaved testids all wired. TEST7 regression: list page renders flawlessly in light mode (warm ivory cards + charcoal type + teal CTA), no console errors; login flow intact; dashboard navigates clean. TEST8 drag stability: 30-step rAF-throttled drag commits new position without jitter; autosave transitions saving → saved. TEST9 layer drop indicator: dragging row[0] toward row[2] correctly renders [data-testid='layer-drop-indicator-below'] as a teal hairline above the target row (visible in screenshot 12_layer_drag).

integration_issues.issue: Playwright could not reliably trigger the modal because the page exposes multiple input[type=file] (library panel + inspector ImageUploader + hidden ones). The implementation path is correct (MoodboardEditor.jsx:1147 → setQuickAdjust({src}) → ImageQuickAdjust mount block at line 1160). Manual verification recommended OR add data-testid='inspector-image-file-input' on the inspector ImageUploader's hidden file input so automation can target it deterministically.

issues: Shipped warm-ivory is rgb(239,234,227) ≈ #EFEAE3. Spec requested #F5F1EB. Marginally cooler than requested; bump --bp-bg in the [data-workspace-mode='light'] block in index.css if pixel-exact match is required (range is within editorial taste — currently still feels like paper, not white).

action_items: Add data-testid='inspector-image-file-input' on the hidden <input type='file'> inside ImageUploader.jsx so automation can target the inspector-side uploader deterministically (or expose a programmatic 'open quick-adjust with URL' fallback).

Soft-pulse dot relies on var(--bp-primary). In light mode the teal must remain the same accent (verified visually). Good — no separate light-mode override needed for the dot color.
